main.description: Record pinning a chat message for prominent display.

pinnedMessage.description: AT-URI of the pinned chat message.

pinnedBy.description: DID of the user who pinned the message.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration time. If set, the pin is considered inactive after this time.

duration.description: How long this pin lasts when expiresAt is not set. 'streamEnd' (the default when unset) keeps the pin active until the livestream referenced by 'livestream' ends. 'forever' keeps the pin active across streams until manually unpinned.

livestream.description: AT-URI of the place.stream.livestream record this pin is scoped to. Set when duration is 'streamEnd' (including the unset default); the pin is inactive unless that livestream exists and has not ended.
